{{Quote|Pirates. I wonder if it's anyone I know...|Mara Jade watching a freighter depart the Katraasii Spaceport|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The '''Katraasii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katraasii]]. Located at the coordinates "O-6,"<ref name="EAOC" /> the Katraasii system also existed within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian Borderlands]].<ref name="Region" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' occured five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' took place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and [[Takara]]'s [[Takara's organization|criminal empire]] held significant control over the system's primary planet and its [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Katraasii Spaceport|city]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Belsmuth sector.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jason Fry and Daniel Wallace placed the Katraasii system within the Belsmuth sector.]]
While the planet Katraasii appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'',<ref name="MOTS" /> the system was not mentioned until the [[2009]] ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. Fry used the "Planetnamia" method to name the system after the appearing planet.<ref name="EAOC" />
